test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the compound interest on Rs. 20000 at 10% per annum for 1 year 6 months, compounded half yearly?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal amount (P) = Rs. 20,000

Annual interest rate (r) = 10% or 0.10

Number of times interest is compounded per year (n) = 2 (half-yearly)

Time period (t) = 1.5 years

**Formula Used:**

A = P(1 + r/n)
